earnings.title: PRESS RELEASE Arch Capital Group Ltd.
highlights: Net income available to Arch common shareholders of $1.0 billion, or $3.00 per share, representing an 18.1% annualized net income return on average common equity, compared to net income available to Arch common shareholders of $1.3 billion, or $3.56 per share, for the 2025 third quarter.

After-tax operating income available to Arch common shareholders (1) of $910 million, or $2.67 per share, representing a 16.0% annualized operating return on average common equity (1) , compared to $1.0 billion, or $2.77 per share, for the 2025 third quarter.
Net income available to Arch common shareholders $ 1,025 $ 1,340
After-tax operating income available to Arch common shareholders $ 910 $ 1,042
Net income available to Arch common shareholders $ 3.00 $ 3.56

quotes.text: We delivered a strong quarter, driven by solid underwriting performance across our three segments and continued strength from our investment portfolio.

items.heading: We operate in a highly competitive environment, and we may not be able to compete successfully in our industry.
items.group: Risks Relating to Our Industry, Business and Operations

items.heading: The insurance and reinsurance industry is highly cyclical, and we may at times experience periods characterized by excess underwriting capacity and unfavorable premium rates.
items.group: Risks Relating to Our Industry, Business and Operations

items.heading: The effects of inflation, trade and tariff disputes and other economic conditions impact the insurance and reinsurance industry in ways which may negatively impact our business, financial condition and results of operations.
items.group: Risks Relating to Our Industry, Business and Operations

items.heading: Claims for natural catastrophic events could cause large losses and substantial volatility in our results of operations and could have a material adverse effect on our financial position and results of operations.
items.group: Risks Relating to Our Industry, Business and Operations

items.heading: The impact of climate change will affect our loss limitation methods, such as the purchase of third party reinsurance and catastrophe risk modeling and risk selection in ways which may adversely impact our business, financial condition and results of operations.
items.group: Risks Relating to Our Industry, Business and Operations

items.heading: Our insurance, reinsurance and mortgage subsidiaries are subject to supervision and regulation. Changes to existing regulation and supervisory standards, or failure to comply with applicable requirements, could adversely affect our business and results of operation.
items.group: Risks Relating to Our Industry, Business and Operations
